actions.reason: K6_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: coordinated up-regulation of proliferation programs (E2F targets, G2M checkpoint) with down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and metabolic programs (rna_pathway_enrichment), and near-universal PBRM1 mutation enrichment (18/18 vs 21/85; OR 111.0, q_global 4.1e-06), the only driver-panel gene surviving global multiplicity control (wxs_mutation_enrichment). These candidate-specific biological findings support an interpretable identity. The set-level cross-modal alignment for K6_C0001 was near zero (silhouettes -0.018 to 0.030), which is weak membership representation, but the partition-level structural screen found no dominant internal subdivision signal and only weak nearest-pair separation, and no candidate-specific confounder evidence has been established. On balance the candidate-specific biological identity plus the absence of a demonstrated competing explanation supports continued treatment of the current membership as an independent unit for downstream stability aggregation.

K6_C0002 shows a coherent biological identity (coordinated down-regulation of immune/inflammatory and antigen-presentation programs with up-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and metabolic programs) and modest positive current-membership alignment in all four modalities (silhouettes 0.025-0.184). The pair-scope structural report for the K6_C0002|K6_C0005 boundary found a near-zero boundary silhouette (0.0007) and a single-cluster-dominated union, which is compatible with removing that boundary but is not sufficient by itself to justify a merge; the pair-scope cross-modal alignment report showed modest positive boundary representation (silhouettes 0.026-0.116), and the two candidates carry opposite-direction immune phenotypes. With no exact-pair structural basis making a one-unit union more defensible than preserving the current units, and no candidate-specific confounder evidence established, the current membership is retained as an independent unit.

K6_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: coordinated up-regulation of immune/inflammatory and interferon programs (interferon gamma NES 3.16, interferon alpha NES 3.12, allograft rejection NES 2.44, TNFA via NFKB NES 2.36) with down-regulation of EMT and myogenesis, supported by shared leading-edge interferon-stimulated and antigen-presentation genes (rna_pathway_enrichment). The set-level cross-modal alignment was near zero in most modalities (silhouettes -0.012 to 0.079), which is weak membership representation, but the partition-level structural screen found no dominant internal subdivision signal and only weak nearest-pair separation, and no candidate-specific confounder evidence has been established. The candidate-specific biological identity with no demonstrated competing explanation supports continued treatment of the current membership as an independent unit.

K6_C0004 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: coordinated down-regulation of immune/inflammatory and interferon programs together with down-regulation of proliferation programs and up-regulation of TGF-beta signaling (rna_pathway_enrichment). The WXS mutation contrast shows no driver-panel enrichment surviving multiplicity control, which is an absence of a detectable mutation signal rather than evidence of equivalence, and does not negate the transcriptomic identity. The set-level cross-modal alignment was near zero (silhouettes -0.056 to 0.027), which is weak membership representation, but the partition-level structural screen found no dominant internal subdivision signal and only weak nearest-pair separation, and no candidate-specific confounder evidence has been established. The candidate-specific biological identity with no demonstrated competing explanation supports continued treatment of the current membership as an independent unit.

K6_C0005 shows a coherent biological identity (coordinated up-regulation of immune/interferon and inflammatory programs with MYC-targets-V2, ROS, and DNA-repair programs) and a specific genomic axis (BAP1 mutation enrichment 9/17 vs 4/86; OR 23.06, q_global 0.018), with modest positive current-membership alignment in all four modalities (silhouettes 0.052-0.117). The pair-scope structural report for the K6_C0002|K6_C0005 boundary found a near-zero boundary silhouette (0.0007) and a single-cluster-dominated union, which is compatible with removing that boundary but is not sufficient by itself to justify a merge; the pair-scope cross-modal alignment report showed modest positive boundary representation (silhouettes 0.026-0.116), and the two candidates carry opposite-direction immune phenotypes. With no exact-pair structural basis making a one-unit union more defensible than preserving the current units, and no candidate-specific confounder evidence established, the current membership is retained as an independent unit.

K6_C0006 has a coherent, interpretable biological identity: coordinated up-regulation of mesenchymal/stromal programs (EMT NES 2.34, UV-response-DN NES 2.19, Hedgehog NES 1.96, angiogenesis, mitotic spindle) with down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and related metabolic and DNA-repair programs, supported by shared leading-edge extracellular-matrix genes (rna_pathway_enrichment). The set-level cross-modal alignment was near zero in most modalities (silhouettes -0.032 to 0.073), which is weak membership representation, but the partition-level structural screen found no dominant internal subdivision signal and only weak nearest-pair separation, and no candidate-specific confounder evidence has been established. The candidate-specific biological identity with no demonstrated competing explanation supports continued treatment of the current membership as an independent unit.
